curb.songTitle: Your Flag Decal Won’t Get You Into Heaven Anymore
curb.line: So I ran the car upside a curb
stanza: Well, I got my window shield
So filled with flags, I couldn't see
So I ran the car upside a curb
And right into a tree
By the time they got a doctor down
I was already dead
And I'll never understand why the man
Standing in the pearly gate said

curb.line: It's everywhere, penthouse, pavement and curb
curb.linePrev: Then the sun bust through the clouds to clearly remind 'em
curb.lineNext: Cradle to the grave, tall cathedral, or a cell

stanza: We're disturbed, we're disturbed
We're the most disturbed
Like we're psychologically disturbed

herb.line: Down to the swimming hole, where there grows a bitter herb
stanza: But I took my fishing pole (fearing your fever)
Down to the swimming hole, where there grows a bitter herb
That blooms but one day a year, by the riverside —
I’d bring it here:

herb.line: They can make hair grease out of fruits and herbs
stanza: My friends are superheros
None of us have very much money though
They can fly, run fast, read Portuguese
None of us have very much money though
They can make hair grease out of fruits and herbs
None of us have very much money though
They can take selfies like Dubuffet
None of us have very much money though
